# add-table

Add one or more tables to the app's sitemap navigation

## Usage

```
ppds model-driven-app add-table [options]
```

## Arguments

| Name | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `entities` | yes | Logical name(s) of the table(s) to add |

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--app` |  | `string` |  | [Required] App display name or unique name |
| `--area` |  | `string` |  | Navigation area name (creates if not found, defaults to first area) |
| `--confirm` |  | `bool` |  | Bypass write protection on production-flagged environments |
| `--correlation-id` |  | `string` |  | Correlation ID for distributed tracing |
| `--debug` |  | `bool` |  | Show trace-level diagnostic output |
| `--environment` | `-e` | `string` |  | Environment URL override |
| `--group` |  | `string` |  | Navigation group name (creates if not found) |
| `--output-format` | `-f` | `OutputFormat` |  | Output format |
| `--profile` | `-p` | `string` |  | Authentication profile name |
| `--publish` |  | `bool` |  | Publish the app after modification |
| `--quiet` | `-q` | `bool` |  | Show only warnings and errors |
| `--solution` |  | `string` |  | Add app (type 80) and sitemap (type 62) to this solution |
| `--title` |  | `string` |  | Display title for the SubArea (defaults to entity's DisplayName, applies to first entity when multiple specified) |
| `--verbose` | `-v` | `bool` |  | Show detailed output including debug messages |
